newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends marginally weaker after light trade.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends marginally weaker after light trade.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar ended marginally weaker on Thursday after a light session spent bumping around in a US$0.6894-07 range.
The Kiwi finished at US$0.6895/02 from its 0.6900/07 open and at 67.45 on the Trade-Weighted Index from 67.48.
Dealers said it was a lacklustre session and that movement in the Australian and U.S. dollars was likely to set direction.
Overnight, the Kiwi was not expected to vary far from a 0.6890-10 range.
